summary: Iteration 31 - Remember Me (Recordarme) and Device Limit Management Features Testing Complete. All new features verified working. Found and fixed 1 bug in device deactivation flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 verified: 1) Recordarme toggle on PWA login - saves code to localStorage, auto-logins on next visit, 2) Device limit management - when login fails with DEVICE_LIMIT error, shows device list with deactivate buttons, 3) After deactivating device, auto-retries login, 4) Logout clears remembered_code from localStorage, 5) Back button on device screen returns to login form. Fixed bug: handleDeactivateDevice was using empty code array when auto-login triggered device limit - added savedCode state to preserve code for deactivation.

recordarme_toggle_ui.details: Toggle appears between code inputs and submit button, starts OFF by default, labeled 'Recordarme'

recordarme_localstorage_save.details: When toggle ON and login succeeds, 'remembered_code' saved to localStorage

recordarme_auto_login.details: When remembered_code exists, login page auto-submits without showing code inputs

get_devices_by_code_endpoint.details: GET /api/my-devices-by-code?code=RMB8S5 returns devices list and max_devices

device_limit_screen_ui.details: Shows amber smartphone icon, device list with names and dates, red trash buttons, back button

device_deactivation_flow.details: After deactivating device, list updates and if under limit, auto-retries login

back_button_device_screen.details: Back button ('Volver al inicio') returns to login form

device_deactivation_empty_code.description: handleDeactivateDevice was using code.join('') which was empty when auto-login triggered device limit
device_deactivation_empty_code.fix: Added savedCode state to preserve the code when device limit is hit, used in deactivation
